title: Kamishiro Rui — Blowing In The Evening Breeze〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
Can we take this stuff away?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is there anything else that needs carrying?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, everything's okay over here.
Thank you, Tsukasa, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anytime! Alright, Emu, let's go.
I'll push the dolly, so you keep an eye on it to make sure everything stays put.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger dodger!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you're free, can you lend me a hand...? We still haven't cleaned up all the flower confetti yet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, sure.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because you've been staring at me for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to discuss? I suspect that you asked me to help clean because there is, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To be fair, I already know why she's worried...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Those two immediately noticed that I was behaving differently... And I couldn't say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, if this is about what happened the other day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know you're okay now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't know what you and Asahi talked about, but I can tell that you feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't feel bad about not telling us about what happened. It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, did you wait all this time to tell me that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. At the same time, when you said that “everything's okay”, it sort of felt like code for “something's wrong”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm sorry about not being able to handle this situation better. I didn't want to bring it back up with you since you seemed to be dealing with it okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, Nene, I really appreciate it...
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
But I kinda just got lucky with this one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu also seems better now after seeing that you've gotten over whatever was bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
Still, I should probably go talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Regardless of what actually happened, I caused you both some bit of trouble. Right before our show too no less.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. You should go talk to her later...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also...
This is really it for our ambassadorial performances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we still get to do shows at the Wonder Stage, so let's start thinking about what we're gonna perform next.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, Emu and Tsukasa might already have some ideas for that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. There certainly is a high chance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There are still plenty of things that I wish to do as the director of Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The underwater show that Emu's been wanting to do being one of them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or having you and Robo-Nene float in the air while throwing in a few explosions...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah... Hm?
H-Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I have plenty of ideas that will challenge Tsukasa by putting his physical limits to the test!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Hehehe...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm glad you're enjoying yourself...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this couldn't be more fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Because we're all together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, Nene, let's clean everything so we can go meet back up with Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay.
